name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 6 visits over 83 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.5 days starting 2025-07-24, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
